entries.title: Generate branded Purchase Orders
entries.description: Purchase Order PDFs now display the Jedidiah logo, matching Quotes.

entries.title: Keep brochure logos clear
entries.description: Product brochures now size compact, wide, and rotated range logos more reliably.

entries.title: Recognize cancelled work quickly
entries.description: Cancelled Jobs and Quotes now use a consistent orange status badge across schedules and detail views.

entries.title: Read the latest Job feedback first
entries.description: Job feedback now appears newest first.

entries.title: Classify Job documents before upload
entries.description: Job document uploads now require you to confirm the document type, preventing accidental misclassification.

entries.title: Understand Supplier invoice processing
entries.description: Invoice filing now clearly explains that AI transcribes the PDF, why the upload may take longer, and that unreadable invoices are still filed.

entries.title: Identify public Product assemblies
entries.description: Public assemblies now display a clear badge in the Product editor.

entries.title: Add raw materials with confidence
entries.description: Product costing now explains that raw materials must use periodic stock tracking and distinguishes loading errors from an empty list.

entries.title: Review bulk Part imports more easily
entries.description: The bulk import dialog is wider and keeps large CSV previews contained.

entries.title: Fix Product save problems faster
entries.description: Autosave now names the rules blocking a save and highlights the affected assembly fields. Parts already used in an assembly are also excluded from its picker.

entries.title: Remove unused customers safely
entries.description: Authorized users can now remove Customers after confirmation. Customers linked to Quotes or other records remain protected.

entries.title: See why Purchase Order actions fail
entries.description: Clear messages now explain why an order cannot be sent, cancelled, or closed short, and why an invoice flag cannot be applied or dismissed.

entries.title: Save Purchase Order quantities accurately
entries.description: Displayed quantities now match the values saved, including when changing between measured Parts and Parts counted in whole units.

entries.title: Recognize cancelled work quickly
entries.description: Cancelled Jobs and schedule entries now use a consistent orange status treatment.

entries.title: Read the latest Job feedback first
entries.description: Job feedback now appears newest first.
